name: lem-stage1-quantitative-inverse-function
source: imports validated registry lemma proofs/lem-stage1-quantitative-inverse-function — Quantitative inverse-function control: if V:X->Y is a Banach-space isomorphism and f:B_r(x_0)->Y is C^1 with ||V^(-1)Df(x)-I|| <= c < 1, then f is injective, (1-c)||x_1-x_2|| <= ||V^(-1)(f(x_1)-f(x_2))|| <= (1+c)||x_1-x_2||, and f(B_r(x_0)) contains f(x_0)+V(B_{(1-c)r}(0)).
